items.prompt: Quote a(23); Quote b(std::move(a)); is followed by a.cents() inside the displayed try/catch. Which result follows from this API?

options.text: The query returns 23 because a const method preserves the old value.
options.why: const restricts access through this call; it does not reverse ownership transfer or preserve an implementation in the source.

options.text: The query returns 0 because every moved-from class resets numeric values.
options.why: There is no universal zero-value rule for moved-from objects; this API explicitly checks an empty pointer.

options.text: The query throws logic_error; b.cents() still returns 23.
options.why: The unique owner moved to b, and the defined cents() guard rejects an empty source before dereferencing it.

options.text: Both a and b must reject queries until either is assigned again.
options.why: The destination owns the original implementation and remains queryable; only the empty source triggers this guard.

items.explanation: The unique owner moved to b, and the defined cents() guard rejects an empty source before dereferencing it.
